versions.changelog: Rewrote frontmatter description to concise 200-500 character trigger metadata for improved agent activation.

Initial release. Drafts a DACS single-level-minimum-compliant finding aid for a processed archival collection — covering title, dates, extent, creator / biographical / historical note, scope and contents, arrangement, conditions governing access and use, processing information, related materials, and an optional series-level container list — for processing archivist and head-of-collections review prior to ArchivesSpace publication.
